newsitem.title: USA: Calif Gov declares L.A., Orange County emergencies.
newsitem.headline: Calif Gov declares L.A., Orange County emergencies.

text.p: California Governor Pete Wilson on Tuesday declared a state of emergency in the counties of Los Angeles and Orange due to damage from wildfires.
Earlier, Wilson declared a state of emergency in San Diego County as a result of the fires.
He also requested a Presidential Declaration of Emergency for the three counties.

"The people whose lives have been disrupted by this terrible disaster not only deserve our sympathy, but all the resources the state can bring forth to help them get through the crisis," Wilson said. "By requesting a Presidential Declaration, we will enable the many residents who lost their homes to receive the proper assistance."

The state of emergency will make mutual aid mandatory from other cities, counties and state agencies, allow the state to reimburse local governments for fire fighting costs, and enable the state to make emergency purchases and redirect money allocated for other purposes.
